title: pwmd: trust-load O(tail) — убрать genesis→tip replay в validate_snapshot_trusted

deadline.note: Beta testnet cold-start SLO: trust load seconds not 15–20 min at 125k+ tip

brief: Архитектурный разрыв: JsonFile trust-load выбирает snapshot_load_mode=trust и грузит только TAIL_BLOCK_CAP=1000 блоков (epochs_ms ~50ms), но validate_snapshot_trusted → trust_tail_prod_idx делает полный replay 1..tip_h с load_block_at_height на каждой высоте (validate_ms ~1.1M ms @68k, ~17–20 min @125k). Snapshot v4 УЖЕ persist epoch_counter + active_validator_indices в summary state (RFC V6-3). Нужен fast-path: доверять checkpoint state для proposer schedule на tail; replay только при epoch boundary внутри tail (≤ epoch_length_blocks), не с genesis. Плюс sequential epoch scan вместо O(n²) random height loads. Progress log для trust validate (как chain_verify). Цель SLO: trust cold start @125k tip <60s на типичном beta PC (was ~15–20 min).
acceptance_criteria: trust_tail_prod_idx (или замена): НЕ loop 1..tip_h при trust; использовать snapshot.state.active_validator_indices + epoch_counter на checkpoint
Если в tail [first_h..tip] нет epoch boundary — verify prod_idx на tail без replay (только header/sig/tx_root checks)
Если epoch boundary B попадает в tail — replay blocks только [B..tip] одним sequential pass по epoch JSONL (не load_block_at_height per height с genesis)
load_blocks_range / sequential epoch iterator — убрать повторное чтение целого JSONL на каждую высоту в hot path
Trust validate: INFO progress каждые ~10s (stage=trust_validate или reuse chain_verify pattern) с height/percent/elapsed

snapshot startup load ok: validate_ms для trust @ tip≥100k — регрессионный unit/bench test или documented benchmark in testing.md; target validate_ms << 60_000 на fixture ~10k blocks (scale linearly documented)
cargo test -p pwmd snapshot incremental io — green (CARGO_TARGET_DIR=F:/pwm-test/pwm-protocol)
docs/guide-node-storage-and-snapshot.md: trust-load = O(tail + optional epoch tail), не genesis replay; SLO note для operators

operator_gate.live_cy: post-merge owner re-measures snapshot startup load ok total_ms on CY @124k+
operator_gate.owner_confirm: 2026-06-17: blocks resume almost immediately after restart post-fix (vs 12+ min loading_snapshot before)

delegations.notes: Implemented trust O(tail) proposer fastpath + tail-boundary sequential range replay; added trust_validate progress logs and trust regression tests.

Trust fastpath meets AC core; boundary pre-boundary None skip is trust-consistent vs RFC V6-3. Nits: tip-seeded boundary replay risky for bnd_h<tip_h+txs; AC#6 timing assert soft; doc one-liner on schedule skip window.

Follow-up for review nit #1: trust_tail_prod_idx now uses direct pick_prod_idx(h, snap_state.active_validator_indices) for h>=bnd_h without replay; keeps None for h<bnd_h. Added regression test trust_prod_tail_bnd_tx_ok for bnd_h<tip_h with non-empty post-boundary txs. Removed now-unused incremental::load_blocks_range helper after replay-path deletion.
Preflight ok (3274MiB). cargo test -p pwmd snapshot: 69/69 PASS (~63s). trust_load_skips_old_replay validate_ms=8054 (N=1105, debug). trust_prod_no_bnd_set + trust_prod_tail_bnd_tx_ok green.

notes: Не путать с full_verify lag (summary_manifest_lag). Это fix trust path при aligned checkpoint. Bitcoin analogy: UTXO set at tip — не replay с genesis для header check tail.
